relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: Banca d'Italia's own gold-reserves page states that the gold is kept in the vaults of the Bank of Italy and of major central banks ("L'oro e custodito nei caveau della Banca d'Italia e di primarie banche centrali"), and that the Italian-held share, 1,100 tonnes or 44.86 per cent of the 2,452-tonne stock, is held in the security rooms at Via Nazionale. The page describes storage only, not management of the holding; the shares held in the United Kingdom (141.2 t), Switzerland (149.3 t) and the United States (1,061.5 t) are given by country with no institution named, so no record is filed for them.
source_title: Banca d'Italia - Riserve in oro (gold reserves)

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: Narodowy Bank Polski's 2025 explainer brochure on gold as a component of its reserves states that of the 448 tonnes held at end-December 2024 about 75 per cent is stored abroad, in roughly similar portions ("w zblizonej czesci") in the vaults of the Bank of England in London and of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, with the remaining quarter held in Poland. The brochure describes vault storage of bars, not management of the holding.
source_title: NBP - Zloto jako skladnik rezerw dewizowych NBP (brochure, 2025)

entity: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same NBP brochure names the Federal Reserve Bank of New York as the second of the two foreign vaults holding the roughly 75 per cent of NBP's 448 tonnes that is stored abroad, split in roughly similar portions with the Bank of England. The brochure states storage, not management.
source_title: NBP - Zloto jako skladnik rezerw dewizowych NBP (brochure, 2025)

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: Danmarks Nationalbank's own page on its gold stock states: "Since 2002, Danmarks Nationalbank has held about 97 per cent of its gold stock at the Bank of England in London." The total stock is about 66.5 tonnes. The page describes where the gold is held, not who manages it.
source_title: Danmarks Nationalbank's gold

entity: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same Danmarks Nationalbank page states that around 0.5 per cent of its gold stock is held at the Federal Reserve Bank of New York; about 2.5 per cent is in Copenhagen, for which the page names no custodian. Storage only, not management.
source_title: Danmarks Nationalbank's gold

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The Czech National Bank's page on its gold states that some of the gold is stored at the CNB's headquarters in Prague, mostly for the production of CNB gold coins, and refers to "the CNB's high security vault in Prague". The page says most of the reserve is stored in London but names no London institution, so no second record is filed. Storage only, not management.
source_title: The CNB's gold - Czech National Bank

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The Bulgarian National Bank's publication on its international foreign exchange reserves states that its gold deposits are settled with "delivery and settlement in Bank of England vaults", and that when gold deposits were suspended under tighter credit-risk constraints "the metal is stored at the Bank of England". The publication says about 60 per cent of the gold is placed outside the BNB's own vaults; it does not name the deposit counterparty banks. Storage, not management.
source_title: Bulgarian National Bank - International Foreign Exchange Reserves

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkiye's 2025 annual report notes state that its gold is kept in TCMB vaults, at Borsa Istanbul and at the Bank of England ("Soz konusu altinlar, TCMB kasalarinda, BIST ve BoE nezdinde muhafaza edilmektedir"). The table of internationally standard gold assigns 119,200,980 grams, about 119.2 tonnes, to the BoE. The report states safekeeping, not management.
source_title: TCMB Yillik Rapor 2025 - 3.4 Aciklamalar (notes)

entity: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye
relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same TCMB 2025 annual report notes record 34,015,944 grams of internationally standard gold, about 34 tonnes, held in the central bank's own vaults, and state that gold not of international standard belongs to the TCMB and is held entirely in TCMB vaults. Safekeeping, not management.
source_title: TCMB Yillik Rapor 2025 - 3.4 Aciklamalar (notes)

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same TCMB 2025 annual report notes name Borsa Istanbul, the Turkish exchange company, as one of the three places where the central bank's gold is kept, with 382,926,774 grams, about 382.9 tonnes, of internationally standard gold assigned to it. The notes state safekeeping ("muhafaza edilmektedir"), not management of the holding.
source_title: TCMB Yillik Rapor 2025 - 3.4 Aciklamalar (notes)

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The Banque de France's page on the management of gold reserves states that it "mainly stores them in an ultra-secure vault known as the Souterraine, which is located 27 metres below ground", and puts the holding at 78.3 million ounces or 2,436.8 tonnes at end-May 2023. The page also notes the Bank provides gold custody services to other institutional clients, a small portion of the gold stored there. The page does not say where any remainder of the French holding is kept.
source_title: Management of gold reserves - Banque de France

name_as_stated: In the country - Banco de Portugal
relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: Banco de Portugal's 2023 annual report, note 2 on gold and gold receivables, introduces a table with the line "Gold was held in the following institutions:" and assigns 5,549,238 fine ounces, about 45 per cent of the 12,302,063-ounce total, to "In the country - Banco de Portugal". The reserve is 382.6 tonnes. The note records where the gold is held, not who manages it.
source_title: Banco de Portugal Annual Report 2023

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same note 2 of Banco de Portugal's 2023 annual report lists the Bank of England among the institutions in which its gold was held, with 5,993,468 fine ounces, about 49 per cent of the 12,302,063-ounce total. Custody, not management.
source_title: Banco de Portugal Annual Report 2023

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same note 2 lists the Bank for International Settlements among the institutions holding Banco de Portugal's gold, with 641,030 fine ounces, about 5 per cent of the total. Custody, not management.
source_title: Banco de Portugal Annual Report 2023

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same note 2 lists the Banque de France among the institutions holding Banco de Portugal's gold, with 118,327 fine ounces, about 1 per cent of the total; the Federal Reserve System line is nil. Custody, not management.
source_title: Banco de Portugal Annual Report 2023

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The National Bank of Belgium's 2025 annual accounts, note 1 on gold and gold receivables, state: "Most of the Bank's gold reserves are held at the Bank of England." The total holding is 227,402.4 kg (7,311,154.9 fine ounces) at end-2025; the note gives no share for each location. It records where the gold is held, not who manages it.
source_title: National Bank of Belgium - Annual accounts 2025 (Report 2025, chapter 3)

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same note 1 states: "A much smaller portion is held at the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) and the Bank of Canada." No share is given. Custody, not management.
source_title: National Bank of Belgium - Annual accounts 2025 (Report 2025, chapter 3)

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same note 1 names the Bank of Canada, alongside the BIS, as holding a much smaller portion of the National Bank of Belgium's gold reserves. No share is given. Custody, not management.
source_title: National Bank of Belgium - Annual accounts 2025 (Report 2025, chapter 3)

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The same note 1 states: "A very limited quantity is stored at the National Bank of Belgium." The accounting principles add that the Belgian State's official gold and foreign exchange reserves on the balance sheet "are held and managed by the Bank". The custody record here is the storage of that very limited quantity in the Bank's own premises.
source_title: National Bank of Belgium - Annual accounts 2025 (Report 2025, chapter 3)

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: Narodna banka Slovenska's own information note on its gold investment reserves states that it owns 31.694 tonnes of gold in physical form (bars) and that "Depozitarom tohto zlata je Bank of England" - the depositary of this gold is the Bank of England - with the specific bars identified there. The note describes depositary safekeeping, not management of the holding.
source_title: Informacia NBS o zlatych investicnych rezervach

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: The Bank of Mauritius's annual report for the year to 30 June 2020, note 7, states: "Gold deposits represent gold bars in storage with Bank of England and on deposits with other counterparties." The note describes storage of the bars; the other counterparties holding gold on deposit are not named.
source_title: Bank of Mauritius Annual Report 2019-20

relation: holds its gold reserves in custody
detail: In a written reply to Parliament, reported by Engineering News in June 2016, Finance Minister Pravin Gordhan stated that a large percentage of South Africa's gold reserves is held at the Bank of England and other unnamed official-sector institutions at offshore bullion centres, with a smaller amount held locally; the offshore holdings then totalled four million ounces. The reply describes where the gold is held, not who manages it; the National Treasury, not the South African Reserve Bank, gave the answer.
source_title: Bank of England, offshore centres holding SA gold worth R75bn (parliamentary reply reported)
